options: A set of connected devices that exchange data
questions.explanation: A network allows connected devices to exchange data and share resources.

questions.text: Which example is typically a WAN?
options: Network connecting offices in different cities
A printer connected by USB only
questions.explanation: A WAN connects networks across broader geographic areas.

questions.text: Why can a printer work on a LAN without internet?
options: The internet is stored in the printer
Wi-Fi automatically creates an internet service
A LAN can carry local traffic independently
questions.explanation: Local devices can communicate without a connection to the global internet.

questions.text: How does the internet differ from a LAN?
options: The internet interconnects many networks globally
The internet is a single computer
questions.explanation: The internet connects many separate networks; a LAN covers a limited area.

questions.text: Why can a phone show Wi-Fi connected but a website fail?
options: Wi-Fi may connect locally while internet access is down
questions.explanation: Wi-Fi connectivity does not guarantee an upstream internet connection.

questions.text: Two laptops need to exchange a file in the same room without internet. What is suitable?
options: Wait until a search engine loads
Use a local network or direct local sharing
questions.explanation: Local file sharing can operate without internet.

questions.text: A school wants computers in one lab to share a printer. Which network fits?
questions.explanation: A LAN is appropriate for a limited location.

questions.text: A learner needs to open an online article hosted abroad. What is generally required?
questions.explanation: Accessing a remote public website generally requires internet connectivity.

questions.text: An office has a functioning LAN, but external websites fail on every computer. Which explanation is most plausible?
options: All local network links must be broken
The upstream internet connection or gateway may be unavailable
The office has too many printers
questions.explanation: The LAN may still work while its internet connection fails.

questions.text: Which setup best supports local file sharing during an internet outage?
options: Devices depending exclusively on a cloud-only server
Devices on the same working LAN with a local file server
Devices with no local storage or connection
questions.explanation: A local server and LAN can remain available during an outside outage.

questions.text: A team calls its classroom Wi-Fi "the entire internet." What correction is best?
options: Wi-Fi can never connect to the internet
A classroom LAN is always a WAN
Every Wi-Fi signal is a different website
Wi-Fi is a wireless way to connect locally; the internet is the larger network of networks
questions.explanation: Wi-Fi is an access technology, not a synonym for the internet.
